description: T-90008 follow-up. In probes/defined-name-body-scope-first-sheet the two bodies that use, bare, a name only the first sheet defines differ in three ways at once: whose body it is (Data's DoubleOwn is #NAME?, the workbook's TripleOwn 30), where the file lists it (XlsxWriter sorts definedNames by name: DoubleOwn before Own, TripleOwn after) and Data being both the first and the active sheet. Only Data defines Own (10). EarlyBook = Own*3 (workbook, listed before Own), ThenBook = Own*3 (workbook, after), Data!EarlyData = Own*2 (Data's, before), Data!ThenData = Own*2 (Data's, after), ThenPin = [0]!Own*5 (the workbook's Own, which is not defined). Here Data is the first sheet and the active one when the file loads, and is moved after Sheet1 before the recalculation.
